question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Spending quality time with friends and family is also __________ to have a healthy daily routine. These happy moments release happy hormones in the body.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**obligatory**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**obligatory**" means required by a legal, moral, or other rule; compulsory.
 
• Spending quality time with friends and family is an essential part of a healthy daily routine, making it an obligatory activity.
